lines.en: The average human body’s chest cavity can withstand a little over 400 lbs of weight before being crushed, but there are several factors that could cause this number to fluctuate.
lines.zh: 人类胸腔平均能承受四百多磅的重量才会被压垮,但有几个因素会让这个数字浮动。

lines.en: On September 18th of 1692, a man by the name of Giles Corey was executed by Captain John Gardner of Nantucket after being accused of and charged with witchcraft.
lines.zh: 1692 年 9 月 18 日,一个名叫贾尔斯·科里的男人,被楠塔基特的约翰·加德纳上尉以行巫罪的罪名处死。

lines.en: But what various historical texts and the acclaimed play adaptation “The Crucible” will not tell you is that there is a very specific reason Mr. Corey was able to withstand a number likely larger than 400 lbs.
lines.zh: 但各种史料和著名的戏剧改编《萨勒姆的女巫》都不会告诉你:科里先生之所以能扛住——很可能超过四百磅——有一个非常特别的原因。

lines.en: Inside his chest cavity was a special worm.
lines.zh: 他的胸腔里,住着一条特别的虫。

lines.en: The worm did not have a name, but it fed on the residue that seeped through Giles’ body until, after consuming enough, it began to grow teeth.
lines.zh: 那条虫没有名字,但它以从贾尔斯身体里渗出的残渣为食;吃得足够多之后,它开始长出牙齿。

lines.en: Giles Corey was an old man. An old man with a young worm. And the young worm wanted to be old one day.
lines.zh: 贾尔斯·科里是个老人。一个带着一条幼虫的老人。而这条幼虫希望有一天自己能变老。

lines.en: So, while Mr. Corey was being pressed to death, it came up with a plan.
lines.zh: 于是,在科里先生被压死的过程中,它想出了一个计划。

lines.en: The worm hardened its body with the help of God as it had been saving up the religious power inadvertently stored by Giles Corey each time he prayed at night.
lines.zh: 虫借助神的力量硬化了自己的身体——那些力量,来自贾尔斯·科里每夜祈祷时无意中储存下的宗教之力。

lines.en: And while this allowed the young worm and the old man to survive slightly longer, it meant nothing in the face of the determined Captain John Gardner of Nantucket.
lines.zh: 虽然这让幼虫和老人多活了一小会儿,但在意志坚定的楠塔基特约翰·加德纳上尉面前,毫无意义。

lines.en: Eventually, the worm and Giles Corey would be crushed to death. And their bodies, still conjoined, would be dumped into a nearby river when their skin refused to burn.
lines.zh: 最终,虫和贾尔斯·科里被活活压死。他们的尸体依然连在一起,因皮肤拒绝燃烧,被扔进了附近的一条河里。

lines.en: But that isn’t the end of the story.
lines.zh: 但故事并没有到此结束。

lines.en: In fact, the story is still going on right now.
lines.zh: 事实上,故事此刻仍在继续。

lines.en: Because when the body of Giles Corey decomposed, so did the worm. And the leftover power of God that allowed the worm to harden its body was dispersed throughout the water.
lines.zh: 因为当贾尔斯·科里的躯体腐烂时,虫也腐烂了。而曾让虫硬化身体的、 leftover 的神力,散进了水里。

lines.en: By the time we found out, it was already too late.
lines.zh: 等我们发现时,已经太迟。

lines.en: We have all drunk from the water.
lines.zh: 我们都喝过那些水。

lines.en: Now, we all have worms inside of us.
lines.zh: 如今,我们体内都有虫。

lines.en: And every time we talk to God, we’re only making them stronger.
lines.zh: 而每一次我们对神说话,都只会让它们更强壮。

lines.en: - The true story of how we came to be
lines.zh: —— 关于我们如何诞生的真实故事

lines.zh: 她的嗓音从来不曾精致,也向来擅长缓缓跑调——

lines.en: : It won’t be a styyyylish marriage~
lines.zh: : It won’t be a styyyylish marriage~

lines.zh: : I caaaan’t affoooord a carriage~

lines.en: But she sounds much worse than normal right now.
lines.zh: 但此刻她的声音比平时糟得多。

lines.en: : But youuuu’ll look sweet upoooon the seat of a bicycle built for twoooooo~
lines.zh: : But youuuu’ll look sweet upoooon the seat of a bicycle built for twoooooo~

lines.zh: 而她看起来更糟。

lines.zh: : I’m haaaaalf craaaaazy, all for the love of youuuuuuu~

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : What have you done?...
lines.zh: : 你做了什么?……

lines.en: : Cut it off and sold it.
lines.zh: : 剪下来,卖了。

lines.en: : What?...
: Don’t you like me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在不喜欢我了吗?

lines.en: : I’m me, Jim.
lines.zh: : 我还是我,Jim。

lines.en: : It’s sold, I tell you— sold and gone, too. It’s the night before Christmas, boy. Be good to me, because I sold it for you.
lines.zh: : 已经卖了,我告诉你——卖掉了,再也不在了。今天是圣诞前夜,乖。对我好一点,因为我是为你卖的。

lines.en: : My hair will grow again. You won’t care, will you? My hair grows very fast.
lines.zh: : 头发还会再长。你不会介意的,对吧?我的头发长得很快。

lines.en: : It’s Christmas, Jim. Let’s be happy. You don’t know what a nice—what a beautiful nice gift I got for you.
lines.zh: : 今天是圣诞节,Jim。我们高兴点。你不知道我给你买了一件多好的——多漂亮的好礼物。

lines.en: Locks of thick, red hair cover the floor like the blood of a lamb who’d just been slaughtered. And in this dark room, where the only light we have is what bleeds through black curtains, I can tell you I’m scared.
lines.zh: 浓密的红发铺满地板,像刚被宰杀的羔羊的血。在这间黑暗的屋子里,唯一的光源是从黑窗帘渗进来的微光——我可以告诉你,我害怕了。

lines.en: It’ll be our little secret. And I’ll become a butcher myself if you give in and let it out.
lines.zh: 这会成为我们俩的小秘密。而只要你屈服、让那个东西露头,我自己也会变成一名屠夫。

lines.en: But in the meantime, I will present myself to my caretaker so that she may hoist me up and attach me to a cold metal device that will hang me upside down- so she can drain the juice from my neck and drink it.
lines.zh: 但在此之前,我会把自己呈给我的照顾者,好让她把我吊起来、挂上一台冰冷的金属装置,把我倒悬——这样她就能从我的脖子里抽出汁液,喝下去。

lines.en: : Don’t you like me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在不喜欢我了吗?

lines.en: : I’m me, Jim.
lines.zh: : 我还是我,Jim。

lines.en: : Ami...put the scissors down.
lines.zh: : Ami……把剪刀放下。

lines.en: : About time! Do you have any idea how much trouble you'd get into if the principal showed up and caught you sleeping right now?
lines.zh: : 可算醒了!你知道校长要是来了、看到你睡成这样,你会有多大麻烦吗?

lines.en: : What?...
: Class ended ten minutes ago. It's time to get up.
lines.zh: : 下课已经十分钟了。该起床了。

lines.en: : Ami, listen to me...you’re not thinking clearly. And I have no idea what’s going on, but I’m here for you now. So give me the scissors and-
lines.zh: : Ami,听我说……你现在神志不清。我不知道发生了什么,但我现在在这里,陪着你。把剪刀给我,然后——

lines.en: : Allow me to re-introduce you to Kumon-mi! A super normal town just outside of Tokyo.
lines.zh: : 请允许我重新向你介绍 Kumon-mi!东京郊外一座超级正常的小镇!

lines.en: : Rule number one is keep your hands off all of your students! But that should probably be a rule that goes without saying since...you know.
lines.zh: : 规则一,不许对学生动手动脚!不过这一条大概不用说,毕竟……你知道的。

lines.en: : That's the part where you were supposed to say, “You're the only girl for me, Ami! I don't care about any of the other ones!”
lines.zh: : 这里本来该轮到你说,「Ami,你是我的唯一!别的女孩我根本不在乎!」

lines.en: : Enough about that, how 'bout we get back to some of those rules you were just talking about?
lines.zh: : 这个先放放,我们回头聊聊你刚才说的那些规则怎么样?

lines.en: : Rule number one is keep your hands off all of your students!
lines.zh: : 规则一,不许对学生动手动脚!

lines.en: : Rule number two is keep your hands off all of your students!
lines.zh: : 规则二,不许对学生动手动脚!

lines.en: : Rules number three and four and five and six are keep your hands off all of your students BUT YOU DIDN’T FOLLOW THE RULES, JIM! YOU NEVER FOLLOW THE RULES!
lines.zh: : 规则三、四、五、六都是,不许对学生动手动脚!可你不守规矩,JIM!你从来都不守规矩!

lines.en: : I know. I’m very bad at that, and I’m sorry. Now, please give me the scissors before you wind up hurting yourself.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我这方面很差,对不起。现在,请把剪刀给我,免得你伤到自己。

lines.en: : やだ。
lines.zh: : やだ。

lines.en: : Ami, please.
lines.zh: : Ami,求你了。

lines.en: : やだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだ。
lines.zh: : やだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだやだ。

lines.en: : Then...what do you want me to do? What can I do?
lines.zh: : 那……你想让我做什么?我能做什么?

lines.en: : YOU COULD HAVE LISTENED!
lines.zh: : 你本可以听进去的!

lines.en: : YOU COULD HAVE FOLLOWED ME LIKE YOU SAID YOU WOULD! COULD HAVE LOVED ME! BUT YOU DON’T LOVE ME AT ALL, JIM! YOU DON’T CARE THAT I SOLD MY HAIR!
lines.zh: : 你本可以像你说过的那样跟着我!本可以爱我!可你根本不爱我,JIM!我卖了头发你根本不在乎!

lines.en: : It’s so pretty, isn’t it? I’ve been growing it forever. You always said you liked twintails. And my hair looks just like mom’s.
lines.zh: : 它很漂亮,对吧?我养了它一辈子。你说过你喜欢双马尾。而我的头发和妈妈一模一样。

lines.en: : You loved her hair too. Loved it a lot. You picked some off a piece of her scalp when it was all we had left. You tasted it. You chewed on the little bits of dead flesh. You wanted to feed your worm.
lines.zh: : 你也爱她的头发。爱得要命。当那已经是仅剩的东西时,你从她的一块头皮上捡了几根。你尝了。你嚼那些死去的小碎肉。你想喂饱你的虫。

lines.en: : Give me...the scissors...
lines.zh: : 把……剪刀……给我……

lines.en: : I HAVE ALREADY GIVEN YOU EVERYTHING!
lines.zh: : 我已经把一切都给你了!

lines.en: : WHAT HAVE I GOTTEN IN RETURN, JIM?! THERE IS NOTHING LEFT! YOU’VE TAKEN ALL OF ME!
lines.zh: : 那我得到了什么回报,JIM?!什么都不剩了!你把我全部拿走了!

lines.en: : ALL OF ME BUT THE ONE THING I WANT YOU TO HAVE! WHAT ARE YOU SO AFRAID OF?!
lines.zh: : 拿走了我的一切,唯独不拿我唯一想给你的那样东西!你到底在怕什么?!

lines.en: : MY INNOCENCE! MY PURITY! MY BLOOD! MY BLOOD AND SWEAT AND BLOOD!
lines.zh: : 我的纯真!我的贞洁!我的血!我的血,我的汗,我的血!

lines.en: : Oh!
: I know.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。

lines.en: : It’s the worm, isn’t it? The worm is making you do the things you do, so I just have to get it out of you! If I get it out of you, you’ll go back to normal!
lines.zh: : 是那条虫,对吧?是虫让你做出这些事的,所以我只要把它从你身体里弄出来!只要弄出来,你就会恢复正常!

lines.en: : What worm?! What are you talking about?!
lines.zh: : 什么虫?!你在胡说什么?!

lines.en: : The one inside you who blocks the path between you and God! The one that kept Giles Corey alive when Captain John Gardner kept increasing the weight! You know the worm I’m talking about!
lines.zh: : 挡在你和神之间的那条虫!约翰·加德纳上尉不断加码时,让贾尔斯·科里撑住的那条虫!你知道我说的是哪条虫!

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about because nothing you’re saying makes any sense!
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么,因为你说的话没有任何一句讲得通!

lines.en: : NOTHING MAKES SENSE HERE! IT’S NOT SUPPOSED TO!
lines.zh: : 这里的一切都不讲得通!本来就不该讲得通!

lines.en: : YOU’RE SUPPOSED TO TREAT THIS LIKE A GAME! YOU’RE SUPPOSED TO GET ME PREGNANT! YOU’RE SUPPOSED TO REACH THE EPILOGUE!
lines.zh: : 你本该把这里当游戏来玩!你本该让我怀孕!你本该抵达尾声!

lines.en: : But all you ever do is lie. You hide the truth because the truth would hurt me. And Ami is fragile! Ami can’t handle it! Ami’s a joke! Ami’s too clingy! Ami is a bad girl!
lines.zh: : 可你只会撒谎。你把真相藏起来,因为真相会伤到我。而 Ami 很脆弱!Ami 扛不住!Ami 是个笑话!Ami 太黏人!Ami 是个坏女孩!

lines.en: : AMI’S NOT A BAD GIRL! AMI’S A GOOD GIRL! AMI’S THE ULTIMATE NIECE! AMI IS CUTE! LOVE AMI MORE! LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE AMI!
lines.zh: : AMI 不是坏女孩!AMI 是好女孩!AMI 是终极侄女!AMI 很可爱!多爱 AMI!爱爱爱爱爱爱 AMI!

lines.en: : I do love you!
lines.zh: : 我是爱你的!

lines.en: : LIAR!
lines.zh: : 骗子!

lines.en: : I called you over and over and over and over and over and over and you never answered! You left me alone! I was worried about you! I thought someone raped and murdered you! You don’t love me at all!
lines.zh: : 我给你打了一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍电话,你从来不接!你把我一个人丢下!我担心死了!我以为你被人强暴杀害了!你根本不爱我!

lines.en: : You think Ami is a bad girl! But you’re wrong! Wrong wrong wrong wrong wrong! Ami is good! I cut off my hair and sold it! I did it for you!
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Ami 是坏女孩!但你错了!错错错错错!Ami 是好女孩!我剪掉了头发卖了它!我是为你做的!

lines.en: : You didn’t sell anything, Ami. It’s all over the ground. It’s everywhere. And I’m sorry I didn’t pick up the phone, I just...didn’t know how to handle this. I was...scared.
lines.zh: : 你什么都没卖,Ami。头发满地都是。到处都是。对不起我没接电话,我只是……不知道怎么面对这些。我……害怕了。

lines.en: : Scared?...
: Yeah...
: I don’t know what to do for you. I don’t know how to help you the way you help me. And you’ve been acting so strangely the last couple days, that I...ran away. Because I always run away.
lines.zh: : 我不知道能为你做什么。我不知道怎么像你帮我那样帮你。而这两天你举止那么反常,以至于我……逃走了。因为我总是逃走。

lines.en: : But I’m here now. And I’m going to help you.
lines.zh: : 但我现在在这里。我会帮你。

lines.en: : Ami doesn’t need help. Ami is normal. She’s a good niece who can do everything you need her to.
lines.zh: : Ami 不需要帮助。Ami 很正常。她是个好侄女,能做好你需要她做的一切。

lines.en: : Then I need you to stop going crazy and give me the scissors. You’ve already ruined your hair. I don’t want you...ruining your face as well.
lines.zh: : 那我需要你停止发疯,把剪刀给我。你已经毁了你的头发。我不想让你……连脸也毁了。

lines.en: : It’s the worm, Jim. The worm is making me do things. I can feel it squirming around in there. I can feel its teeth.
lines.zh: : 是那条虫,Jim。是虫在让我做这些事。我能感觉到它在里面扭动。我能感觉到它的牙齿。

lines.en: : Give-
: I’M NOT DONE YET! YOU CAN’T HAVE THEM!
lines.zh: : 我还没说完!你不能拿走它们!

lines.en: : I will take them if I have to, Ami. I’m much stronger than you are.
lines.zh: : 必要的话我会抢的,Ami。我比你强壮得多。

lines.en: : You’re weak! A crybaby! You tear up when I read you bedtime stories! Your eyes glaze over in sakura season! You are nothing without me! Nothing!
lines.zh: : 你很弱!爱哭鬼!我给你读睡前故事你就掉眼泪!樱花季你就两眼放空!没有我你什么都不是!什么都不是!

lines.en: : You think I don’t know that?! You really think I don’t understand everything you’ve done for me?!
lines.zh: : 你以为我不知道吗?!你真以为我不明白你为我做的一切?!

lines.en: : Get away from me! You’re a fake! A liar! A half-eaten replica! You just want to feed the worm!
lines.zh: : 离我远点!你是假的!是骗子!一个被啃了一半的复制品!你只想喂饱那条虫!

lines.en: : Give me the fucking-
lines.zh: : 把那该死的——

lines.en: : Ngh!
: LET GO LET GO LET GO LET GO LET GO LET GO LET GO I NEED TO CUT THE WORM OUT LET GO LET GO I NEED TO KILL IT LET GO NEED TO KILL THE WORM LET GO LET GO I HAVE TO SAVE MY INSIDES LET GO!
lines.zh: : 放开放开放开放开放开放开放开我要把虫割出来放开我要杀了它放开要杀了那条虫放开放开我必须拯救我的内脏放开!

lines.en: Twin blades sink into the sensitive flesh of my palm as I pull Ami’s hand closer.
lines.zh: 双刃剪刀刺进我掌心柔软的皮肉,同时我把 Ami 的手拉近。

lines.en: She struggles, as I expect her to, causing the scissors to dig deeper into my skin as I frantically attempt to figure out what I’m going to do when I have control of them.
lines.zh: 她挣扎着,一如我的预料;剪刀在我疯狂盘算夺下之后该怎么办时,深深陷进我的皮肤。

lines.en: She’s a danger to herself and anyone she encounters in this state. And while that’s not something I’m prepared to handle, I knew it was only a matter of time until something like this happened.
lines.zh: 在这种状态下,她对自己、对任何靠近的人都是危险。虽然我毫无准备,但我早知道,这种事的发生只是时间问题。

lines.en: But why now?
lines.zh: 可为什么是现在?

lines.en: What about waking up from my two months of “rest” ignited this wildfire within her mind? And why does her shattering coincide with mine when I’m the one who lost something?
lines.zh: 从两个月的「休养」中醒来这件事,怎么会点燃她脑内的这场野火?而失去东西的人是我,为什么她的崩溃与我的同步?

lines.en: Does she really think she’s losing me?
lines.zh: : 她真的以为自己正在失去我吗?

lines.en: Is going through my phone and exposing the truth all it took to break her?
lines.zh: : 翻我的手机、揭露真相,仅此而已就足以击碎她吗?

lines.en: : Huh?
: Let...go...
: Huh? What? How? Huh? Why? Why? How? What?
lines.zh: : 咦?什么?怎么?咦?为什么?为什么?怎么?什么?

lines.en: : Did I...no no no no no no. No! No, it wasn’t me! I wouldn’t do that! It was the worm! The worm did it!
lines.zh: : 难道是……不不不不不。不!不,不是我!我不会那样做的!是那条虫!是虫干的!

lines.en: : Sensei, it was the worm! It wasn’t me! I’m a good girl! Ami is a good girl!
lines.zh: : Sensei,是那条虫!不是我!我是好女孩!Ami 是好女孩!

lines.en: Somehow, this feels familiar.
lines.zh: 不知为何,这一切似曾相识。

lines.en: There was someone just like her who used to lick my wounds.
lines.zh: 曾有一个和她一模一样的人,替我舔舐伤口。

lines.en: She would dress them before dressing me, and she would numb the pain of existing with her hands and her mouth.
lines.zh: 她会先替伤口更衣,再替我更衣;她会用她的手和嘴,麻痹「存在」本身的痛。

lines.en: But in hindsight, I sometimes believe she only did this because she liked the taste of blood.
lines.zh: 但事后回想,我有时觉得她那样做,只是因为她喜欢血的味道。

lines.en: : Sensei! It wasn’t me! It was an accident! I would never...no! I didn’t do that!
lines.zh: : Sensei!不是我!是意外!我绝不会……不!我没有那样做!

lines.en: : It’s fine. It’ll heal on its own. It’s not like you pierced all the way through my hand or anything.
lines.zh: : 没事。会自己愈合的。又没把我的手整个穿透,不是吗。

lines.en: : Ah.......ah.........hah! No! No, I didn’t...No no no no no. No! No, no, no! No!
lines.zh: : 啊………啊………哈!不!不,我没有……不不不不。不!不,不,不!不!

lines.en: : Ami, look at me.
lines.zh: : Ami,看着我。

lines.en: : What is going on with you?
lines.zh: : 你到底怎么了?

lines.en: : Is it all because of me?
lines.zh: : 这一切都是因为我吗?

lines.en: : Did I make it worse? Or is it my fault entirely? Be honest.
lines.zh: : 是我让它更糟了吗?还是说全都是我的错?说实话。

lines.en: : Would you rather just go to your room like I did?
lines.zh: : 还是你宁愿像我一样,回房间躲起来?

lines.en: : Do you want to stay in bed for the next two months while I sponge-bathe you and read you bedtime stories? Will that help?
lines.zh: : 你想不想在床上躺上两个月,让我替你擦身、给你读睡前故事?那样有帮助吗?

lines.en: : You what?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么了?……

lines.en: : I just want to be pure.
lines.zh: : 我只是想变得纯洁。

lines.en: Ami collapses to the floor when I retreat to the kitchen for some paper towels to wrap my hand in.
lines.zh: 我去厨房找纸巾包手时,Ami 瘫倒在地上。

lines.en: Within seconds, she begins to hyperventilate. And it looks to me as if she’s lost all will to live.
lines.zh: 几秒之内,她开始过度换气。在我看来,她像失去了活下去的全部意愿。

lines.en: Like hurting me, even if it was in accident brought on by this fit of hysteria, signified to her that she is a failure.
lines.zh: 仿佛伤害了我——哪怕是一场歇斯底里引发的意外——就向她宣告了:她是个失败者。

lines.en: But she’s not a failure.
lines.zh: 但她不是失败者。

lines.en: She’s like this because I have failed her — and not just because I’ve been absent during the last twenty-four hours in which she needed me most.
lines.zh: 她变成这样,是因为我辜负了她——而不仅仅是因为在她最需要我的最后二十四小时里,我缺席了。

lines.en: I’ve been absent her entire life.
lines.zh: : 我缺席了她的一生。

lines.en: And even when I was present, it was more like I was a ghost.
lines.zh: : 即便在场的时候,我也更像一个幽灵。

lines.en: I can feel the one that’s been following me put her hands on my shoulders.
lines.zh: : 我能感觉到一直跟着我的那位,把双手放上了我的肩。

lines.en: I hear her whisper into my ear.
lines.zh: : 我听见她在耳边低语。

lines.en: : What have you done to my darling little girl?
lines.zh: : 你对我的宝贝女儿做了什么?

lines.en: I can’t bring myself to respond. But she doesn’t go away.
lines.zh: : 我开不了口回应。但她不走。

lines.en: She pulls up a chair at the dining room table and watches as I stand here, useless and confused.
lines.zh: : 她在餐桌旁拉开一把椅子坐下,看着我站在这里——无用而茫然。

lines.en: All the while, Ami’s humanity slowly drifts away.
lines.zh: : 与此同时,Ami 的人性一点点漂走。

lines.en: What’s left is just a worm.
lines.zh: : 剩下的只是一条虫。

lines.en: But the worm inside me senses its presence.
lines.zh: : 但我体内的那条虫,感知到了她的存在。

lines.en: : WAAAAAAAAAAAAAaaaaaAAAAAAAaaaaAAAAaahhhhaahhhha!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 哇啊啊啊啊啊AAAAAaaaaAAAaahhhaahhhha!!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: : I’M SO SORRY!!!!!!! I’M SO SORRY!!!!!!!!!! IT WAS AN ACCIDENT!!!!!!!!! AAAAAAAAaaaaaahhhhaaaaaa!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 对不起!!!!!!!对不起!!!!!!!!!!是意外!!!!!!!!!啊啊啊啊aaaaaahhhhaaaaaa!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: The worms need to be together.
lines.zh: : 虫需要彼此。

lines.en: It’s the only way they’ll ever feel like they belong.
lines.zh: : 那是它们感到归属的唯一方式。

lines.en: I know now what the scissor angel warned me of, but this accident brings me no closer to God nor Heaven’s Web.
lines.zh: : 现在,我终于明白了剪刀天使的警告,但这场意外并没有让我更接近神,也没有更接近天堂之网。

lines.en: It brings me closer to ruin — and the idea that this world may have already come to an end. And this is all that’s left.
lines.zh: : 它让我更接近毁灭——以及一个念头:这个世界也许早已终结。而眼前,就是全部的残余。

lines.en: But now that the one that I love the most is gone, it creates an opening.
lines.zh: : 但如今我最爱的那个消失了,这就留下了一个空位。

lines.en: A new love can take its place.
lines.zh: : 新的爱可以取而代之。

lines.en: And what better candidate than the girl who’s been beside me all along?
lines.zh: : 还有什么候选人,比一直陪在我身边的这个女孩更合适?

lines.en: What better candidate than the one who will take care of me when I can no longer move?
lines.zh: : 还有什么候选人,比我动弹不得时会照顾我的她更合适?

lines.en: What better candidate than the one who can’t survive without me?
lines.zh: : 还有什么候选人,比离开我就活不下去的她更合适?

lines.en: Maybe what I felt before wasn’t love at all as it was seldom accompanied by this level of fear.
lines.zh: : 也许我从前感受到的根本不是爱——因为它很少伴随这种程度的恐惧。

lines.en: And maybe acknowledging that is what it will take for me to finally be happy.
lines.zh: : 而也许,承认这一点,才是我最终获得幸福所需要的那一步。

lines.en: I put Ami to bed.
lines.zh: 我安顿 Ami 上床。

lines.en: She’s yet to stop crying.
lines.zh: : 她还没有停止哭泣。

lines.en: I left our doors open so I can hear her from all the way in here.
lines.zh: : 我把我们房间的门都敞开,好让我在这里也能听见她。

lines.en: But her voice is not that of a siren’s.
lines.zh: : 但她的声音并不是海妖的歌声。

lines.en: I will go to her when she needs me.
lines.zh: : 她需要我的时候,我会去她那里。

lines.en: But I can sense that it will be quite some time before she comes to me.
lines.zh: : 但我感觉得到,离她来找我,还有相当长的时间。

lines.en: But is that enough to keep me here?
lines.zh: : 可这足以留住我吗?

lines.en: Is there any amount of time that I can wait before a new love takes the place of the one that I have lost?
lines.zh: : 在新的爱取代失去的那份之前,我又能等多久?

lines.en: I have so many options, but none of them feel right.
lines.zh: : 我有那么多选项,却没有一个感觉是对的。

lines.en: Should I just give in and be with Ami after all?
lines.zh: : 我是不是干脆屈服,最终和 Ami 在一起算了?

lines.en: Should I cast aside the one virtue I’ve managed to keep clasped inside my hands and just...find something else to hold instead?
lines.zh: : 我是不是该把我好不容易攥在手心的那点德行丢掉,然后……找点别的握着?

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: Maybe this fear...this uncertainty is just another part of growing up.
lines.zh: : 也许这种恐惧……这种不确定,只是长大成人的又一部分。

lines.en: But if that’s the case, I wonder why it’s taken me over thirty years to start.
lines.zh: : 但如果是这样,我不明白为什么我花了三十多年才开始。

lines.en: Even more than that, though...
lines.zh: : 更重要的是……

lines.en: I wonder how long it will take to finish.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还要多久才能长大完。

lines.en: Because, between you and me?
lines.zh: : 因为,只告诉你一个人?

lines.en: This is hell.
lines.zh: : 这里就是地狱。

lines.en: But it’s right where I belong.
lines.zh: : 但它正是我归属的地方。

lines.en: I put Ami to bed.
lines.zh: : 我安顿 Ami 上床。

lines.en: She’s yet to stop crying.
lines.zh: : 她还没有停止哭泣。

lines.en: I left our doors open so I can hear her, but it’s only getting worse.
lines.zh: : 我把我们的门都敞开着,好听见她;但情况只会越来越糟。

lines.en: She screams for hours about how sorry she is.
lines.zh: : 她哭喊着自己的抱歉,喊了好几个小时。

lines.en: She screams about a worm.
lines.zh: : 她哭喊着一条虫。

lines.en: Tomorrow, a new stage of my life will begin.
lines.zh: : 明天,我人生的新阶段即将开始。

lines.en: But will it be better than all the ones before it?
lines.zh: : 但它会比之前的所有阶段都好吗?

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: But there’s only one way to find out.
lines.zh: : 但只有一条路可以弄清答案。

lines.en: I close my eyes.
lines.zh: : 我闭上眼。

lines.en: And when I dream that night, I see the same clockwater bed that I always do.
lines.zh: : 那晚入梦时,我看到的依旧是我常看到的那张时钟水床。

lines.en: But there’s no one on it this time.
lines.zh: : 只是这一次,上面没有人。

lines.en: There’s just a box.
lines.zh: : 只有一个盒子。

lines.en: Ami Arakawa has obtained the status effect [[BEDRIDDEN]!
lines.zh: Ami Arakawa 获得了状态效果 [[BEDRIDDEN(卧床不起)!

lines.en: I wake up to sunlight pouring in through the window.
lines.zh: 我在洒进窗的阳光中醒来。

lines.en: But there’s nothing I want to do.
lines.zh: : 但我什么都不想做。

lines.en: So I spend the morning watching Ami sleep.
lines.zh: : 于是我花了整个上午,看着 Ami 睡觉。

lines.en: I have a feeling I’ll be doing that a lot now.
lines.zh: : 我有一种预感:接下来我会经常这样。

lines.en: Akira Arakawa has obtained the status effect [[DEPRESSED]!
lines.zh: Akira Arakawa 获得了状态效果 [[DEPRESSED(抑郁)!

lines.en: When Akira is inflicted by [[DEPRESSED], the things he once enjoyed no longer sound appealing to him!
lines.zh: 当 Akira 陷入 [[DEPRESSED 时,他曾经喜欢的事物,听起来都不再有吸引力!

lines.en: Some options may no longer be available to him as a result of this.
lines.zh: 因此,某些选项可能对他不再开放。

lines.en: But don’t worry!
lines.zh: : 但别担心!

lines.en: All he has to do is get over it!
lines.zh: : 他要做的只是「振作起来」!

lines.en: Once he does that, everything will go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 一旦做到,一切都会恢复正常。

lines.en: And the worm will feed once more.
lines.zh: : 而那条虫,会再次进食。

lines.en: [totaldays] Days have passed...
lines.zh: [totaldays] 天过去了……

lines.en: I wake up again.
lines.zh: 我再次醒来。

lines.en: What do I want to do?
lines.zh: : 我想做什么?

lines.en: Take care of Ami
lines.zh: 照顾 Ami

lines.en: I take care of Ami.
lines.zh: : 我照顾了 Ami。

lines.en: Afternoon comes.
lines.zh: : 下午来了。

lines.en: Now, what should I do?
lines.zh: : 现在,我该做什么?

lines.en: Take care of Ami
lines.zh: 照顾 Ami

lines.en: I take care of Ami.
lines.zh: : 我照顾了 Ami。

lines.en: She isn't getting any better.
lines.zh: : 她没有任何好转。

lines.en: Night comes.
lines.zh: : 夜晚来了。

lines.en: Now, what should I do?
lines.zh: : 现在,我该做什么?

lines.en: Take care of Ami
lines.zh: 照顾 Ami

lines.en: I finish the day off by taking care of Ami.
lines.zh: : 这一天结束时,我照顾了 Ami。

lines.en: It's time to go to bed.
lines.zh: : 该睡觉了。

lines.en: The worm grows.
lines.zh: : 虫在长大。

lines.en: [totaldays] Days have passed...
lines.zh: [totaldays] 天过去了……

lines.en: I wake up again.
lines.zh: 我再次醒来。

lines.en: Someone slid a note under my bedroom door in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 半夜,有人从我的卧室门缝下塞进来一张纸条。

lines.en: I can only imagine who it must have been.
lines.zh: : 我只能想象那是谁。

lines.en: I pick it up and read it.
lines.zh: : 我捡起来读。

lines.en: All it says is-
lines.zh: : 上面只有一句话——

lines.en: You don't have to wait for me.
lines.zh: : 你不必等我。

lines.en: I should keep myself busy.
lines.zh: : 我该让自己忙起来。
